pairs.kalshi_text: Fed decision in Oct 2026? Hike 25bps
pairs.kalshi_rules: If the Federal Reserve does a Hike of 25bps on October 28, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
pairs.poly_text: Will the Fed increase interest rates by 25 bps after the October 2026 meeting?
pairs.poly_rules:
The FED interest rates are defined in this market by the upper bound of the target federal funds range. The decisions on the target federal funds range are made by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings.

This market will resolve to the amount of basis points the upper bound of the target federal funds rate is changed by versus the level it was prior to the Federal Reserve's October 2026 meeting.

If the target federal funds rate is changed to a level not expressed in the displayed options, the change will be rounded up to the nearest 25 and will resolve to the relevant bracket. (e.g. if there's a cut/increase of 12.5 bps it will be considered to be 25 bps)

pairs.kalshi_text: How low will the 10-year US Treasury yield get by Oct 30, 2026? 5.05% or below

pairs.poly_text: Will the 10-year Treasury yield dip below 5.05% in October?
pairs.poly_rules:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the Treasury 10-year yield is lower than the listed value for any date between October 2, 2026 and October 31, 2026. Otherwise this market will resolve to "No".

This market will resolve as soon as the Treasury 10-year yield is lower than the listed value, or once data is available for the last business day of October 2026. If no qualifying value is published and data is not available for the last business day of October 2026 by November 13, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "No".

The resolution source for this market is the Department of the treasury, specifically the data listed under "Daily Treasury Par Yield Curve Rates" for the column "10 Yr"
